# API Input Validation Quality Checklist: Input Values Constraints and Validation

**Purpose**: Exhaustive field-by-field requirements quality review validating input boundaries, typing constraints, and error reporting across all microservices
**Created**: 2026-09-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness: Reservation Service

- [x] CHK001 Are all valid lifecycle states explicitly enumerated for reservation status transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are allowed state transitions completely specified from each lifecycle status? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are minimum and maximum bounds defined for reservation party size (1 to 50 guests)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are minimum and maximum bounds defined for reservation duration (15 to 480 minutes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Are email format validation rules and maximum length constraints (255 chars) documented for customer bookings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is the authoritative cancellation window snapshotting behavior on booking creation completely documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Are temporal boundaries for reservation `startTime` specified differently for customer vs manager roles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK008 Is a maximum character length defined for customer display name on reservation creation? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Completeness: Restaurant Service

- [x] CHK009 Are maximum length constraints specified for restaurant trade name (150 chars) and address (1000 chars)? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK010 Are valid timezone format requirements defined using standard IANA identifiers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Are lower and upper bounds specified for default reservation duration (15 to 480 minutes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Are lower and upper bounds specified for minimum booking advance lead time (0 to 10,080 minutes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK013 Are lower and upper bounds specified for maximum forward booking horizon (1 to 365 days)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 Are lower and upper bounds specified for restaurant cancellation notice window (0 to 168 hours)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK015 Are physical table seating capacity bounds specified between 1 and 50 seats? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK016 Is the minimum table count for virtual table combinations explicitly defined as at least 2 tables? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK017 Are day-of-week integer constraints specified to fall strictly between 1 (Monday) and 7 (Sunday)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK018 Is the requirement that `closeTime` must be strictly after `openTime` on active schedule days clearly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Completeness: Waiting List, Customer & Availability Services

- [x] CHK019 Are date constraints specified for waiting list requests requiring target date to be current or future? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK020 Is the time interval ordering constraint (`earliestTime` <= `latestTime`) explicitly required on waiting list entries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK021 Are party size bounds (1 to 50 guests) consistently specified for waiting list queueing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK022 Are first name and last name length limits (1 to 50 chars) and non-blank constraints specified for customer profiles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK023 Are telephone number length boundaries (5 to 25 chars) and valid contact characters specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK024 Are dining date and party size bounds specified for table availability queries? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK025 Is "clock-skew grace period" quantified with an exact threshold (5 minutes / 300 seconds)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK026 Is the deprecation and ignoring of the client-supplied `cancellationWindowHours` query parameter unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK027 Are field-level validation error responses required to adhere to RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` with an `invalidParams` list? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK028 Are the exact property names within `invalidParams` items specified as `name` and `reason`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Is party size bounding (1 to 50 guests) consistent across reservation, availability, and waiting list specifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK030 Are whitespace-only strings explicitly specified to be treated as blank and rejected? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Is the behavior for requests omitting optional fields specified to preserve valid default values? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Are terminal state lifecycle rules specified to disallow updates from completed, cancelled, or no-show reservations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK033 Does the specification explicitly guarantee that legacy database records outside new constraints are not retroactively invalidated? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]

## Measurability & Non-Regression

- [x] CHK034 Can the 100% rejection rate for out-of-bounds inputs be objectively verified by automated tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK035 Can the requirement that existing reactor test suites continue to pass without regression be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK036 Is the performance overhead of validation execution bounded by a measurable latency target (<10ms)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
